Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is a modern chemical enterprise located at No. 136, Qingchun Road, Hangzhou, Zhejiang, China, in one of the country’s most dynamic economic and innovation hubs. Benefiting from Hangzhou’s strong industrial base, transportation links, and talent resources, the company operates at the intersection of traditional chemical manufacturing and emerging new-material technologies.

As a “new materials” oriented chemical company, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. is typically involved in the research, development, production, and sale of specialized chemical products designed to improve performance, efficiency, and sustainability in downstream applications. These can include materials and additives used in areas such as industrial formulations, surface treatments, functional polymers, and other high-value chemical solutions that support manufacturing, infrastructure, and consumer products.

The company’s positioning in Hangzhou, a city known for both technological innovation and advanced manufacturing, allows it to integrate scientific research with practical industrial needs. By focusing on product quality, reliability, and technical support, Zhejiang Runhe Chemical New Material Co., Ltd. aims to build long-term partnerships with domestic and international clients. Leveraging continuous improvement and adherence to relevant standards and regulations, the company seeks to contribute to the broader development of China’s chemical new materials sector while supporting more efficient and innovative end-use industries.
